title: Our Founding
description: Founded with over two decades of experience, Neon Insurance Brokers was established with a clear mission: to provide professional, client-first insurance brokerage services in Uganda.

title: Pioneering Passenger Protection
description: In partnership with UAP Insurance, we launched 'Musabaaze Sure,' a first-of-its-kind, affordable travel insurance policy designed to protect everyday upcountry bus travelers.

title: Licensed & Certified
description: As a fully licensed broker and a proud member of the Insurance Brokers Association of Uganda (IBAU), we are committed to upholding the highest standards of ethics and professional practice.

title: Building Trust, One Client at a Time
description: Through dedicated advocacy and tailored solutions, we have steadily grown our client base, becoming a trusted partner for both personal and commercial insurance needs.

title: A Commitment to the Future
description: Our focus remains on empowering a thriving and secure community by providing unparalleled expertise and unwavering support, ensuring our clients are protected.
